name: Can I use a Move-Up Buyer Program if I need to move to a different county, for example from Miami-Dade to Collier County?

mainEntity.name: Can I use a Move-Up Buyer Program if I need to move to a different county, for example from Miami-Dade to Collier County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, our Move-Up Buyer Program is designed to assist clients across different counties within our service areas, including transitions from Miami-Dade to Collier County. We have local market expertise in all the counties we serve, enabling us to help you sell your current home and find a new one in your desired location. This requires coordination between our team members or network in the respective regions to ensure a consistent level of service and a smooth transition, managing the logistics of a longer-distance move effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, our program can facilitate moves between counties like Miami-Dade and Collier, leveraging our local expertise across our service areas for a smooth transition.
